pages.text: A 7x7x7 cage: $(item)Containment Frame$() on all twelve edges and the $(item)Event Horizon Controller$() in the middle of a bottom edge, facing out. $(item)Horizon Ports$() go anywhere in the frame.$(br2)The inner 5x5x5 must be empty. The faces between the edges can be left open or filled with anything, like glass.

pages.name: Event Horizon Reactor
pages.text: Controller in the front bottom edge, an Input port east, an Output port west.

1,000 mB of antimatter ignites a black hole in the middle. Feed it items through Input ports, the controller, or by throwing them in; it turns their mass into power. Starved for a minute, it collapses.$(br2)$(#FF5050)$(bold)Anything that walks into the field dies, even in creative.$() Switch the reactor off with redstone before going in.
